answer: Agents anchor identity to a bonded cold-storage vault whose keys are sharded across geographically dispersed nodes, as sparse as sensors on a tundra, so that one compromised site cannot mint identities. Each registration broadcasts a comet-like beacon hash chained to the prior epoch, forcing sybil clusters to replicate costly proof-of-work across all shards. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
